name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Gambit does not go with Judit if and only if Caro-Kann goes with Pin.
Exactly two members of the King's-Pawn Camp are in the Morning Study Group.
Either Pin goes with Caro-Kann or Garry goes with Fork.
Gambit goes with at least one of Nadia, Caro-Kann, or Pirc.
Between Garry and Caro-Kann, one goes with Pin and the other with Skewer.
Either Nadia goes with Fork, or Caro-Kann goes with Gambit — but not both.

hints.text: Suppose Garry went with Fork — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Garry goes with Fork.
Garry goes with Fork, so it can't also go with Pin.

…but now the clue “Between Garry and Caro-Kann, one goes with Pin and the other with Skewer” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Garry does not go with Fork.
